idea-plugin.name: Syrobin Java Code Generate
idea-plugin.description:
Syrobin Java Code Generate is a full-featured, intelligent Java backend & full-stack code generator plugin for IntelliJ IDEA, designed to eliminate repetitive scaffolding work and accelerate microservice & enterprise application development.

Syrobin Java Code Generate 是一款面向 IntelliJ IDEA 的全功能、智能化 Java 后端与全栈代码生成插件，旨在消除重复的脚手架编码工作，全面提速微服务与企业级应用研发。

Key Features (English)

  • 14-Template Full-Stack & Multi-Module Generation: One-click or modular generation of Entity, BO, VO, Query, Enum, Mapper, Mapper.xml, MapStruct Converter, Service, ServiceImpl, ServiceQuery, ServiceResults, Controller, and Frontend TypeScript/Axios API with per-layer Maven/Gradle sub-module routing and One-to-Many master-detail cascade generation.
  • Multi-Dialect & Offline DDL AST Engine: Supports live metadata extraction and dynamic Maven/Gradle JDBC driver loading for MySQL, PostgreSQL, Oracle, and Dameng (DM8), plus 100% offline DDL parsing (including COMMENT ON TABLE / COLUMN and ALTER TABLE ADD COLUMN).
  • PSI AST Incremental Merge, Live Diff & One-Click Rollback: Preserves hand-written business methods and custom imports via IntelliJ PsiJavaFile AST merging and CodeStyleManager formatting, with double-click single-file or batch DiffRequestChain live preview and transactional LocalHistory batch rollback.
  • Team Contract, Sidebar ToolWindow & Live Template Workbench: Share project conventions via .syrobin-codegen.json, store credentials securely in OS keychain via PasswordSafe, access the resident Syrobin CodeGen sidebar ToolWindow, and edit all 14 FreeMarker templates with side-by-side real-time rendering preview in Settings.

核心特性（中文说明）

  • 14 套模板全栈生成、主子表联表与多模块分层投递：支持一键生成 Entity、BO、VO、Query、Enum、Mapper、Mapper.xml、MapStruct Converter、Service、ServiceImpl、ServiceQuery、ServiceResults、Controller 与前端 TypeScript/Axios API，支持跨 Maven/Gradle 子模块路由、表前缀剥离、BaseEntity 公共基类继承及主子表（One-to-Many）级联生成。
  • 多方言动态驱动加载与全语法离线 DDL 引擎：原生适配 MySQL、PostgreSQL、Oracle、达梦（DM8），支持从本地 Maven/Gradle 仓库动态加载 JDBC 驱动，支持解析 PostgreSQL/Oracle 表外 COMMENT ON TABLE/COLUMN 及 ALTER TABLE ADD COLUMN 语句，并支持从 IDEA Database 面板右键直连生成。
  • PSI 语法树级智能合并、双击/批量 Diff 预演与一键回滚：基于 IntelliJ PsiJavaFile 抽象语法树与 CodeStyleManager 精准合并新增字段、枚举项与缺失 import，支持单文件双击或整表批量 DiffRequestChain 预演，并集成 LocalHistory 支持一键回滚最近一次生成批次。
  • 常驻侧边栏 ToolWindow、团队共享契约与实时模板沙箱工作台：提供常驻右侧的 Syrobin CodeGen 工具窗口，支持导出 .syrobin-codegen.json 纳入 Git 团队共享，接入 PasswordSafe 钥匙串保护密码，并在 Settings 中提供左右分栏实时渲染的 FreeMarker 模板工作台。
idea-plugin.change-notes:
v3.0.0 - Enterprise Architecture, PSI AST Engine, Master-Detail & Live Workbench (3.0 企业级全栈架构升级)

  • M1 - PSI AST Merge & Multi-Module Routing (PSI 语法树合并与多模块路由): Upgraded IncrementalCodeMerger to IntelliJ PsiJavaFile AST + CodeStyleManager, added double-click single-file and batch DiffRequestChain live preview, table prefix stripping (t_, sys_), BaseEntity inheritance, per-layer sub-module routing, PasswordSafe credential storage, and .syrobin-codegen.json team contract.
  • M2 - Multi-Tech-Stack Workbench & Full-Dialect Engine (多技术栈实时工作台与全方言引擎): Added skl_mapper_xml.xml.ftl and skl_converter.java.ftl (MapStruct), supported BEAN_UTILS / MAPSTRUCT / HUTOOL conversion strategies, upgraded Settings into a split-pane live FreeMarker sandbox workbench, supported PostgreSQL/Oracle COMMENT ON TABLE/COLUMN & ALTER TABLE ADD COLUMN in offline DDL parser, added dynamic Maven/Gradle JDBC driver loading, and integrated IDEA Database ToolWindow popup menu.
  • M3 - Master-Detail Modeling, Frontend TS API, ToolWindow, LocalHistory Rollback & i18n (主子表联表、前端 TS 生成、常驻侧边栏与一键回滚): Added One-to-Many SubTableRelation cascade generation in BO/VO/ServiceImpl, added skl_frontend_api.ts.ftl for TypeScript interfaces and Axios API generation, registered resident Syrobin CodeGen ToolWindow, integrated LocalHistoryHelper for one-click batch rollback, and added CodeGenBundle bilingual internationalization.
